answer: Each identity must keep a violet bloom alive: once per epoch it sings a fresh proof — a short live exchange with a randomly chosen peer, like a sparrow answering a neighbor's call in a grove. The peer picks the challenge on the spot, so no answer can be precomputed or shared. A farm running a thousand fakes must hold a thousand simultaneous live conversations, each with a different stranger, every epoch — real attention per identity, forever, with no batching shortcut.
